$comment: Public repositories for the quiet benchmark (Track B2). Sparse paths keep clones small. Plain CSS only: the audit does not parse SCSS yet.

repos.name: radix-themes
repos.notes: Token-driven CSS with --space-N custom properties. Expected to infer its own scale.

repos.name: mantine
repos.notes: CSS Modules. Spacing tokens are --mantine-spacing-*, which the default spacing pattern does not match; a fallback here is a token-discovery to-do.

repos.name: primer-react
repos.notes: CSS Modules using --base-size-N tokens. Same token-discovery caveat as Mantine.

repos.name: liveblocks-react-ui
repos.notes: Already consumes stylelint-plugin-logical-css through a shared config; a realistic embed target.

repos.name: shadcn-ui
repos.notes: Tailwind v4 with @theme in globals.css plus TSX class strings; exercises the Tailwind side of the audit.

repos.name: open-props
repos.notes: A token library, not a component library. Sizes are --size-N, so the spacing pattern will miss them; included to measure the cost of that gap.

repos.name: mittwald-flow
repos.notes: SCSS-only under the scanned path, so the audit finds no CSS. Kept as the explicit marker of the SCSS scope gap.
